forms.edition: 2025; draft e-copy 29 Aug 2025, launched 6 Jan 2026; drafted by Pinsent Masons for HKIA / HKIS / HKICM
forms.note: Takes account of CISPO (Cap. 652). Reported changes (secondary source, not yet checked against the form): programme submission and updating in the conditions, float and EOT interaction, restructured payment timelines and pay-less notices with day counts in the Appendix, stricter variation notice windows, retention bond option. The HKIA-ARB PA Paper 2 study guide (2021) cites the 2005 / 2006 editions: confirm the edition for the exam sitting.

oral_instruction_confirm_days.text: Contractor confirms an oral instruction in writing within 5 days of it being given

objection_to_instruction_days.text: within 7 days of receipt of that instruction

claim_particulars_days.text: particulars of a claim for additional payment within 60 days of the notice under 28.1

eot_further_particulars_interval_days.text: further particulars of a continuing delay at intervals not exceeding 28 days

retention_default_pct.text: rate of retention, if not stated 10 per cent (5% is the market norm)

retention_limit.text: limit of retention as stated in the Appendix (commonly 5% of the Contract Sum)

half_retention_release_days.text: half of retention released within 14 days after the Substantial Completion Certificate

final_retention_release_days.text: balance within 14 days after the Defects Rectification Certificate

defects_liability_period.text: period stated in the Appendix (12 months is usual for building works)

final_certificate.text: as soon as practicable after the Defects Rectification Certificate

mediator_agreement_days.text: if no agreement on a mediator within 21 days of a written request, appointed by institute presidents

mediation_period_days.text: if not settled within 28 days of commencement of mediation, either party may refer to arbitration

arbitration_rules.text: domestic arbitration under the Arbitration Ordinance (Cap. 609), HKIAC Domestic Arbitration Rules

interim_certificate_and_honouring.text: interim payment interval, certification period and honouring period are in clause 32 and the Appendix: enter from the actual contract

articles.7: SOP Particular Conditions apply, apply with amendments, or do not apply, as selected in the Appendix
articles.8: BIM Particular Conditions apply, apply with amendments, or do not apply, as selected in the Appendix

master_programme.text: within 42 days of acceptance of the tender

defects_liability_period.text: 12 months from Substantial Completion of the Works, a Section or a Relevant Part

payment_period.text: within 14 days from the date of the certificate

retention_limit.text: plus the Retention held for Nominated Sub-Contractors and Nominated Suppliers

final_account_period.text: within 12 months from Substantial Completion of the whole of the Works

listed_events.note: Called listed events, not Relevant Events, in this edition. Read the form for the wording. Topics include force majeure, weather, Architect's instructions, nominated sub-contractors and suppliers, pandemic or epidemic measures, and acts of prevention or breach by the Employer.

differences_from_2005: Mediation period is 42 days in clause 41.4(1), against 28 days in the 2005 form.
Clause 26 covers delay recovery measures, with proposals due within 14 days of instruction.

cispo._source: CIC SOPL briefing (https://www.cic.hk/content/dam/sopl/docs/sopl-briefing-en.pdf) and CMS legal update, read 2026-11-06. Not legal advice.
cispo.name: Construction Industry Security of Payment Ordinance (Cap. 652)
cispo.in_force: 2025-08-28, for contracts entered into on or after that date; Security of Payment Rules in operation 2025-09-05

thresholds.subcontracts: covered if the main contract is

cispo.private_scope: New works covered; existing buildings covered except occupied residential and non-residential works not needing BA approval. Composite buildings: only BA-approved works in non-residential parts count. EOT disputes under private contracts: adjudication not yet in force (later phase).
cispo.payment_claim: on the contract date, else the last day of a calendar month; one claim per progress payment
cispo.no_response_effect: paying party cannot raise set-off (e.g. LD) in adjudication
cispo.conditional_payment: pay-when-paid and pay-if-paid prohibited, no exceptions
cispo.working_day: excludes general holidays, Saturdays, black rainstorm and gale warning days
